ambient_square_coordinate_family.purpose: shows that fixed seven-line factor shape alone cannot imply a fixed specialization-prime set; these points are NOT claimed to lie on C_H or in the physical receiver
ambient_square_coordinate_family.infinitely_many_prime_divisors_proof: if a finite prime set T contained every prime divisor of 1+n^2 for all n>=1, let N be the product of T (or N=1 if T is empty); any prime divisor r of 1+N^2 is not in T because N=0 mod r would imply 1+N^2=1 mod r, contradiction
